sn45.3:1.2: Then the Venerable Sāriputta approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
sn45.3:1.3: “Venerable sir, this is the entire holy life, that is, good friendship, good companionship, good comradeship.”
sn45.3:2.2: This is the entire holy life, Sāriputta, that is, good friendship, good companionship, good comradeship.
sn45.3:2.3: When a bhikkhu has a good friend, a good companion, a good comrade, it is to be expected that he will develop and cultivate the Noble Eightfold Path.
sn45.3:2.4: “And how, Sāriputta, does a bhikkhu who has a good friend, a good companion,
sn45.3:3.2: a good comrade, develop and cultivate the Noble Eightfold Path?”
sn45.3:4.3: The rest as in the preceding sutta.
